query:
SELECT c.id, c.fullName, c.mobileNumber, 
       (SELECT SUM(p.totalPrice) FROM packages p WHERE p.customerId = c.id AND p.paymentStatus != 'paid') as unpaidAmount
FROM customers c
HAVING unpaidAmount > 0
ORDER BY unpaidAmount DESC
LIMIT 20;
